mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(M.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') DATE, SUM(CASE WHEN M.ROLE = 'user' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) USER_MESSAGES, COUNT(*) TOTAL_MESSAGES, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(M.CREATED_AT)) * 1000 LAST_MESSAGE_AT FROM T_CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN T_CHAT C ON C.ID = M.CHAT_ID WHERE C.HOST = #{userId} AND C.CLIENT = #{userId} AND M.TYPE = 'TEXT' AND M.CONTENT <> '' GROUP BY DATE ORDER BY DATE DESC

SELECT M.CHAT_ID, M.NUM, M.TYPE, M.CONTENT, M.ROLE, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(M.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT FROM T_CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN T_CHAT C ON C.ID = M.CHAT_ID WHERE C.HOST = #{userId} AND C.CLIENT = #{userId} AND M.TYPE = 'TEXT' AND M.CONTENT <> '' AND DATE(M.CREATED_AT) = #{date} ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT, M.CHAT_ID, M.NUM
SELECT CHAT_ID, NUM, TYPE, CONTENT, ROLE, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT FROM T_CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE CHAT_ID = #{id} ORDER BY NUM DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_CHAT_MESSAGE(CHAT_ID, NUM, TYPE, CONTENT, ROLE) VALUES (#{chatId}, #{num}, #{type}, #{content}, #{role})
INSERT INTO T_CHAT_MESSAGE(CHAT_ID, NUM, TYPE, CONTENT, ROLE) VALUES (#{chatId}, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(M.NUM), 0) + 1 FROM T_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.CHAT_ID = #{chatId}), #{type}, #{content}, #{role})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE CHAT_ID = #{chatId} AND NUM = #{num}
